findings.observation: Complete-source X geometry is computed for 37 of 42 public catalog entries. Primary HDBSCAN produces multiple groups in 36, without broad resampling qualification.
findings.confidence: High for the executed numerical descriptions; limited for stability, nuisance mechanism and biological independence.
findings.consequence: Structural susceptibility can be investigated before target or metadata admission; parameter-specific groups do not demonstrate shortcut learning.
findings.action: Preserve all entry-level blockers, qualify component-aware stability and verify explanatory source metadata before stronger interpretations.

findings.observation: Only 12 of 37 X0 profiles support full-axis nearest neighbors under the frozen product bound; none meets the prespecified 1e-6 relative proximity threshold.
findings.confidence: High for those numerical populations and tolerances; unavailable for omitted full-axis neighborhoods and physical repetition.
findings.consequence: No absence-of-redundancy or independent-sample conclusion applies to the other sources or to larger tolerances.
findings.action: Qualify a bounded upstream neighborhood method before expanding dimensions; never infer physical duplication or silently downsample.

findings.observation: Litter Ridge and SNV/PLS improve intact errors relative to raw PLS while preparation-transfer errors remain substantially larger and depend on the fitted design.
findings.confidence: Exploratory, conditional on 298 development sample bags and 24 declared plot/context blocks; higher biological independence is not identified.
findings.consequence: Benchmark suitability and observed estimator robustness are separate properties; reference improvement does not certify transfer robustness or low structural dependence.
findings.action: Report every frozen design and matched 297-ID preparation contrast; obtain collection, tree and assay links before new-population claims.

findings.observation: Original-keyed crop nitrogen has weak observed X-partition and species association, while leaf-to-plant and assay ownership remain unresolved.
findings.confidence: Descriptive for 183 finite matched leaf records; independent predictive support unavailable.
findings.consequence: Weak measured association and missing metadata do not establish a low-dependence benchmark.
findings.action: Obtain the original plant/time/assay map before admitting a grouped predictive experiment.

findings.observation: The initial paired-source integrity audit compared retained numeric references and mislabeled its access flag. The corrected adapter ignores those cells; 24 adversarial mutations preserve exact sanitized task and transfer inputs.
findings.confidence: High for the explicit access correction and exact input invariance; model fits, hyperparameter selection and performance scoring always used development outcomes only.
findings.consequence: The original source-audit flag needs the published correction; unchanged model inputs and folds permit preserving the executed numerical evidence.
findings.action: Retain the correction, source-level adversarial gates and guarded exact checkpoint reuse.

findings.observation: The paired retained-X probe flags 0 of 24 intact and 22 of 24 ground spectra while preserving the complete training fitted state exactly.
findings.confidence: High for the fixed numerical support contrast; explanatory and post-response, with no retained-outcome evaluation.
findings.consequence: Preparation changes geometric support. Coverage flags do not estimate prediction-failure probability or identify a shortcut mechanism.
findings.action: Keep this support probe separate from the frozen predictive experiment and validate any stronger interpretation on independent source populations.

findings.observation: Many other public target tables still lack an original-key, unit and reference audit in this release.
findings.confidence: High for recorded availability; no inference about their unexecuted associations.
findings.consequence: The two newly qualified XY cases cannot estimate target-structure prevalence across the bank.
findings.action: Broaden original-keyed XY admission before adding heavy models in the next bounded iteration.
